messages:
Alex: Heads up — eu1 dedicated pool is at ~98% GPU allocation, automatic spillover to hosted kicked in ~5m ago. Noticed a ~2x cost delta on the billing dashboard.
Priya: Looking at the autoscaler logs now, provisioning laged out around a scale event. Some nodes failed init.
Marco: Agree; preemptible churn + AZ packing caused scheduling slowdowns. Seeing container evictions in eu1-a.
ops-bot: [ALERT] cluster/eu1/gpu_util > 95% — fallback routing enabled (policy=hosted-fallback-v3). Link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/AC-4872
oncall-bot: fallback policy triggered by autoscaler at 1893450123, affected orgs: 12 (mostly low-priority).
Sara: Quick proposal: drain the lowest-priority orgs to hosted fully and warm up 4 reserved nodes in eu1 to reduce spillover. Also throttle low-priority quota to avoid more host fallthrough.
Liam: Any evidence of network path issues between eu1 and hosted? I saw intermittent 504s for some requests earlier. Could be NAT gateway or load balancer.
Alex: 504s match the timestamp of the first spillover. Run a targeted check: ```curl -v https://hosted-infer.eu1.redwood/api/health``` — if LB times out we'll see it.
Priya: Running `rctl get pool eu1 --format=wide` now: returns "GPU used=98, GPUs free=2, queued=180, pending_provision=6". Autoscaler backlog is visible.
Marco: I'm starting warm nodes via the provisioner. Command: ```./provision --region eu1 --count 4 --type p4d --label=warm-standby``` — ETA ~6m.
Sara: I'll open a temporary routing change: shift 20% of low-priority traffic to hosted immediately, monitor latency and cost for 5m, then step to 40% if stable. If errors spike >2% rollback.
Liam: Spinning a synthetic load at 200 qps against hosted endpoints to validate tails. Will report p95.
Priya: I've got a hotfix ready for autoscaler: increase max_nodes eu1 120->150. PR #4521. If approved and rolled, we should see provision backlog drain faster.
Alex: Finance — can you confirm we're okay with short-term cost increase if it avoids request failures?
Finance: Finance is aware and ok with a temporary bump; please tag us in any cost alerts. We'll watch hourly.
Marco: Warm nodes up: 4 nodes provisioned and joining the cluster (node IDs: n-eu1-092, n-eu1-093, n-eu1-094, n-eu1-095). Starting instance initialization logs...
ops-bot: [INFO] pool eu1 update: max_nodes=150 (patched), warmstandby nodes added=4.
oncall-bot: rollback safety policy armed: if latency p95 > 1200ms or error rate > 2% in next 10m -> auto-shift back 100% to hosted.
Priya: Autoscaler PR merged and deployed at 1893450900. Provision backlog moved from 6 -> 0 over 4m.
Liam: Synthetic looks OK so far: p95=320ms, error rate 0.4% at 200qps. No LB 504s observed during this run.
Sara: Executed step1 weight shift at 1893451200: low-priority weights -> hosted 20%. Monitoring...
Alex: Cost spike dampened a little but still up ~35% vs baseline — expected. How are customer-facing latencies?
Marco: Latency for high-priority routes unchanged. Low-priority p95 improved slightly.
Priya: Suggest we keep step plan: +20% every 5m until we hit <80% GPU util or cost alerts. Also re-evaluate packing and preemptible eviction schedule.
Finance: Received hourly cost digest — marking as watch. Alert threshold set at +50% cost.
Alex: Action items: Priya - follow autoscaler logs and revert any bad changes; Marco - verify node packing and eviction heuristics; Sara - manage routing shifts and rollback hooks; Liam - keep synthetic running for 30m; Finance - watch billing.
Sara: I'll also open a short RFC for improving fallback granularity so we can prefer partial model variants instead of full hosted fallthrough.
Marco: Noted. Will look at model shard placement to reduce cross-az skews.
Alex: Cool. If anything degrades or cost > +50% we rollback to hosted-only for low-priority and file an incident postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup: :eyes:
Priya: Closing loop — will post a follow-up thread at 1893453600 with metrics snapshot and next steps.
Alex: Thanks — stand down unless alerts reappear.
